title: Tuition Assistance Orientation Class

sections.heading: Tuition Assistance Orientation Classes
sections.markdown:
You will learn:

* eligibility requirements to obtaining and maintaining Military TA
* how to apply for TA through the WebTA system
* FAFSA information will also be provided
